## What you wanted

State the task, host/model if known, and skill version.

## Fictional reproduction

Use invented people and employers. Do not include real CVs, private histories, credentials, contact details or application responses.

## What happened

Include the relevant output and explain the specific problem.

## What would make it useful

Describe the desired behaviour, including relevant factual boundaries or tone preferences.
